run_rust_io_tests: run Rust programs against input/output test cases and check if outputs match expected results
compile_rust_program: compile a Rust source file using rustc with a configurable compilation timeout
process_rust_code: detokenize tokenized Rust code back into valid source code using the RustProcessor

review_rust_evaluator_class: review the RustInputOutputEvaluator class that extends InputOutputEvaluator for Rust language support
